name: Glossary Tooltips
description: Define your terms once. The first time each one appears on a page it gets a small, accessible tooltip with its definition, reachable by mouse, touch and keyboard. Headings, links and code are left alone.

panels.title: Glossary tooltips
panels.description: Terms and their definitions. The first time a term appears on a page it is underlined and shows its definition on hover, tap or keyboard focus. Changes apply to a page the next time it is published.

fields.name: enabled
fields.title: Show glossary tooltips
fields.description: Turn this off to leave every page exactly as it was rendered.

fields.name: terms
fields.title: Terms
fields.description: One per line: the term, a colon, then its definition. For example: SEO: Search engine optimisation, making pages easy to find. Add spellings with a vertical bar, like API | APIs: ... Lines starting with # are ignored.

fields.name: match-case
fields.title: Match case
fields.description: Match case exactly. Off, "api" in your list also matches "API" on a page.

fields.name: color
fields.title: Colour
fields.description: The underline or highlight. Leave empty for amber (#ca8a04).

fields.name: exclude
fields.title: Pages to skip
fields.description: Slugs, separated by commas, that never get tooltips. For example: home, contact
